# Lessons Index

本索引按 `lessons-record` 分层规范维护当前仓库的完整 lessons。开始任务时先读取 `docs/lessons.md`；只有当前任务、错误信息、工具名或 tags 命中本表时，再读取对应 topic。

| LESSON-20260701-config-excerpt-repo-boundary | repository, templates, scope | 判断当前仓库角色、修改 AGENTS / Skill 模板、迁移配置摘录 | 当前仓库是配置摘录 / 同步源，不是真实业务项目。 | topics/repository-workflow.md#lesson-20260701-config-excerpt-repo-boundary-config-excerpt-repo-boundary |
| LESSON-20260701-project-agents-template-boundary | agents, templates, scope | 修改 `AGENTS.project.md`、根 `AGENTS.md` 或全局 / 项目模板 | 项目级 AGENTS 模板不得镜像配置仓库根 AGENTS。 | topics/repository-workflow.md#lesson-20260701-project-agents-template-boundary-project-agents-template-boundary |
| LESSON-20260701-local-sync-explicit-trigger | sync, local-config, scope | 同步本仓库配置到本机实际生效路径 | 本地配置同步必须由用户明确输入 `同步` / `sync` 触发。 | topics/repository-workflow.md#lesson-20260701-local-sync-explicit-trigger-local-sync-explicit-trigger |
| LESSON-20260718-sync-table-current-source | sync, agents, source-of-truth, automation, skills | 执行本地 sync、增加 bundled Skill 或维护 automation 验证范围 | 显式 sync 必须从当前工作树的 tracked `AGENTS.md` 同步表生成目标清单，并用测试锁定 bundled Skill source / target 映射。 | topics/repository-workflow.md#lesson-20260718-sync-table-current-source-sync-tables-must-use-current-tracked-rules |
| LESSON-20260719-orca-automation-detached-agent-pty | orca, automation, terminal, pty, renderer, debugging | 手动运行 Orca automation 后新终端空白、只显示旧 shell prompt 或没有 Agent 进度 | 按 run 的 `terminalPtyId` 关联 terminal metadata；同 tab / leaf 的 renderer 绑定空闲 shell 而 Agent PTY detached 是运行时 pane binding 问题，不是 prompt 未执行。 | topics/repository-workflow.md#lesson-20260719-orca-automation-detached-agent-pty-blank-automation-tabs-can-hide-a-detached-agent-pty |

| LESSON-20260718-required-controls-tracked-source | repository, controls, gitignore, bootstrap, review | 修改根 `AGENTS.md` / `ENTRYPOINT.md`、启动 Gate、追踪或忽略策略 | 启动必需文件必须由 Git 追踪，或有 tracked canonical source 和 Gate 前 bootstrap；不得 ignored / untracked 后又设为全操作前置条件。 | topics/repository-workflow.md#lesson-20260718-required-controls-tracked-source-required-controls-need-a-tracked-source |

| LESSON-20260719-block-edit-resolved-range | editing, ast, tests, recovery, validation | 使用结构化 block edit 替换类中的单个方法或相邻声明 | block edit 后必须立即核对 resolved range；单方法结束行已知时优先精确范围，异常先恢复并运行所属测试类。 | topics/validation-scripts.md#lesson-20260719-block-edit-resolved-range-verify-structural-edit-resolved-ranges-immediately |
| LESSON-20260719-installer-compatibility-contracts | shell, powershell, installer, stdin, encoding, bom, contracts | 跨平台安装器修改输入、非交互参数、编码、文件合并或外部 CLI 落点 | 回归必须覆盖 closed stdin、yes/no 强制确认、PowerShell BOM、BOM 文件幂等、已有目标覆盖和版本化路径 allowlist。 | topics/validation-scripts.md#lesson-20260719-installer-compatibility-contracts-installer-compatibility-needs-boundary-fixtures |
| LESSON-20260701-bdd-first-feature-language-gate | bdd, gherkin, validation | 新增首个 `.feature` 或修改 BDD 语言规则 | BDD 首个 `.feature` 语言规则必须有写入前和验证门。 | topics/bdd-e2e-reports.md#lesson-20260701-bdd-first-feature-language-gate-bdd-first-feature-language-gate |
| LESSON-20260701-web-ui-test-assets-path-gate | e2e, web-ui, assets | 生成 Web UI 测试资产或 selector audit | Web UI 测试资产路径规则必须有参数和验证门。 | topics/bdd-e2e-reports.md#lesson-20260701-web-ui-test-assets-path-gate-web-ui-test-assets-path-gate |
| LESSON-20260701-e2e-report-artifact-status-separation | e2e, reports, playwright | Playwright / Maestro 运行产生报告产物但测试未全绿 | E2E 报告文件生成与测试通过状态必须解耦。 | topics/bdd-e2e-reports.md#lesson-20260701-e2e-report-artifact-status-separation-e2e-report-artifact-status-separation |
| LESSON-20260701-playwright-summary-html-stem | e2e, playwright, reports | 生成 Playwright HTML / JSON / JUnit 报告汇总 | Playwright Markdown 汇总不得以 `results.json` 为 stem。 | topics/bdd-e2e-reports.md#lesson-20260701-playwright-summary-html-stem-playwright-summary-html-stem |
| LESSON-20260701-playwright-runner-output-dir-separate | e2e, playwright, reports, output-dir | Playwright HTML 报告被下一轮运行清空，或设计正式报告保存目录 | Playwright runner 临时 `outputFolder` 必须和正式命名报告快照目录分离。 | topics/bdd-e2e-reports.md#lesson-20260701-playwright-runner-output-dir-separate-playwright-runner-output-dir-separate |
| LESSON-20260704-diagnostic-run-formal-report-gate | e2e, reports, api, playwright, maestro, validation | API / Web E2E / Mobile E2E / Hybrid E2E 使用 stdout-only、terminal-only、`--reporter=list` 或未启用 reporter 的诊断命令后收尾 | 诊断命令不能满足正式报告 gate；正式验证必须补 reporter、捕获 raw report 或标记 blocked。 | topics/bdd-e2e-reports.md#lesson-20260704-diagnostic-run-formal-report-gate-diagnostic-run-formal-report-gate |
| LESSON-20260717-readonly-mode-mutation-intent-gate | bdd, knowledge-ingest, routing, skills | 为 Skill 增加只读模式或设计关键词路由 | 只读模式必须同时要求明确只读意图、排除变更意图并定义模式优先级。 | topics/bdd-e2e-reports.md#lesson-20260717-readonly-mode-mutation-intent-gate-read-only-mode-mutation-intent-gate |
| LESSON-20260717-evidence-post-commit-revision-boundary | evidence, git, pr, validation, ci | 正式证据、sidecar、envelope 或 PR Check 需要证明 PR head | commit/rebase/merge/amend 是证据版本边界，之后必须针对最终 head 刷新或使旧证据失效。 | topics/bdd-e2e-reports.md#lesson-20260717-evidence-post-commit-revision-boundary-evidence-post-commit-revision-boundary |
| LESSON-20260728-trellis-omp-pi-flag-separation | onboard, trellis, omp, pi, installer, validation | 维护 Onboard 的 Trellis 平台参数、安装器帮助或全局 Skill 初始化引导 | OMP 与 Pi 是独立 Trellis flags，必须用 argv 级回归测试锁定 `--omp`、`--pi` 和传入顺序。 | topics/repository-workflow.md#lesson-20260728-trellis-omp-pi-flag-separation-keep-omp-and-pi-trellis-flags-distinct |
| LESSON-20260827-trellis-init-empty-yes-defaults | onboard, trellis, init, platform, installer, validation | 维护 Onboard `init` / `plan` 的 Trellis 平台参数、Agent `--platform` 与 `trellis init` 的映射 | 空 Trellis flag 加 `--yes` 不是中性省略，而是 Claude+Cursor 默认；精确命中的 Agent 平台应成为默认 Trellis flag。 | topics/repository-workflow.md#lesson-20260827-trellis-init-empty-yes-defaults-empty-trellis-init-flags-are-not-neutral |
| LESSON-20260811-stable-promotion-candidate-prune-safety | onboarding, stable-mirror, promotion, symlink, migration, validation | 修改 external Skill stable promotion、清理上游删除的 Skill 目录或实现 stable prune | stable 镜像清理必须只在 promotion candidate 中执行，先拒绝 `skills/` symlink，再以解析后的受管根检查目标路径并原子替换。 | topics/repository-workflow.md#lesson-20260811-stable-promotion-candidate-prune-safety-stable-promotion-pruning-must-stay-contained |
| LESSON-20260811-external-skill-legacy-identity | onboarding, skills, migration, safety, data-preservation, validation | 修改 external Skill rename、legacy cleanup 或 reset migration | 旧目录名不是所有权证明；在备份或删除 predecessor 前必须校验其 `SKILL.md` frontmatter 与预期 legacy identity 一致，冲突必须 fail closed。 | topics/repository-workflow.md#lesson-20260811-external-skill-legacy-identity-legacy-skill-deletion-needs-identity-proof |
| LESSON-20260814-gitnexus-native-module-transport | gitnexus, mcp, node, native-module, transport | GitNexus MCP 报 `Transport closed` 或全局安装启动失败 | 先验证生效 command 和真实 MCP handshake；缺少 LadybugDB native module 时运行该安装目录的 lifecycle repair。 | topics/repository-workflow.md#lesson-20260814-gitnexus-native-module-transport-gitnexus-mcp-needs-its-native-module |
| LESSON-20260824-gitnexus-claude-json-shebang-path | gitnexus, mcp, claude, omp, path, shebang, transport | OMP 报 `Failed: gitnexus [config: ~/.claude.json]: Transport closed`，或 GUI / 干净 PATH 启动 gitnexus | `gitnexus` shebang 依赖 PATH 上的 `node`；Claude MCP 配置必须钉死 nvm 绝对 `node` + CLI 路径。 | topics/repository-workflow.md#lesson-20260824-gitnexus-claude-json-shebang-path-pin-claude-gitnexus-mcp-to-explicit-node |
| LESSON-20260831-readonly-cli-probe-side-effect | onboard, cli, omp, side-effect, validation, read-only | `check` / preflight / provider detection 调用第三方 CLI 查询版本、plugin 或配置 | 第三方 CLI 的只读子命令也可能 bootstrap 配置；缺失配置根时不得启动会产生状态的 CLI。 | topics/repository-workflow.md#lesson-20260831-readonly-cli-probe-side-effect-read-only-checks-must-not-bootstrap-cli-state |
| LESSON-20260831-paginated-edit-source-truncation | editing, tools, pagination, truncation, tests, recovery | 编辑超长文件且读取结果含分页 / elision / `Showing lines` footer | 分页展示不得作为整文件写回来源；大文件编辑后立即检查行数、语法、diff stat 和 footer。 | topics/validation-scripts.md#lesson-20260831-paginated-edit-source-truncation-never-rewrite-large-files-from-paginated-tool-output |
